coreResponsibility.summary: A Kaltura Player JS plugin that integrates Google Analytics (Universal Analytics and GA4) to track and report video player events and user engagement metrics.

featureOwnership: Google Analytics integration (Universal Analytics UA and GA4)
Video player event tracking to Google Analytics
Player lifecycle event tracking (play, pause, seek, ended, fullscreen)
Error event tracking with severity filtering
dataLayer population for Google Tag Manager
dataHandling: Google Analytics tracking IDs (UA-* and G-*)
Player event payloads (action, category, label, value)
Time percent event flags for milestone deduplication

upstream.name: @playkit-js/kaltura-player-js
upstream.description: Parent player framework that provides BasePlugin, event system, and player instance

upstream.name: @playkit-js/playkit-js
upstream.description: Core playkit library providing player events, utilities, and error definitions

downstream.name: Google Analytics
downstream.description: Receives tracked events via gtag API

downstream.name: Google Tag Manager
downstream.description: Receives events through dataLayer for further processing

externalApis.name: Google gtag.js
externalApis.description: Google's global site tag library for sending analytics data

externalApis.name: Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
externalApis.description: Next-generation Google Analytics with event-based data model

externalApis.name: Google Universal Analytics
externalApis.description: Legacy Google Analytics using tracking IDs (UA-*)

entryPoints.description: Main entry point that registers the googleAnalytics plugin with Kaltura Player
Core plugin class extending BasePlugin with all tracking logic
Default event tracking configuration mapping player events to GA actions
